warmup: cd web && npx --yes corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
install: cd web && npx --yes corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

web.cmd: timeout 120 sh -c 'until curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8081/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && cd web && exec npx --yes corepack pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT" --strictPort
